title: Timer
saveFailed: Timer is working. Couldn’t save its state.
holdOptions: Touch and hold for timer options
usage: Start a full-screen countdown as the background fills up. Touch and hold to pause, resume, or end the timer. When time is up, the screen flashes. Tap to dismiss.
persistence: Changing the system clock keeps the countdown running. The timer continues after you leave the app. After a device restart, the last saved time remaining is restored. Tap Resume to continue.
